mechanism: top-k over the step candidate pool, k = round(n * (1 - rejection_rate))
note: kept = accepted + protected. Protected batches are floor overrides OPUS would otherwise have discarded; folding them into 'accepted' would hide exactly how much work the floor is doing, which is the number S5 needs.

rate_definitions.observed_rejection_rate: per-STEP selection pressure over the oversampled candidate pool; floor of 1 - 1/oversample
rate_definitions.observed_supply_rejection_rate: fraction of DISTINCT judged samples never admitted on any step; comparable to the plan's rejection_rate_target and the one that drives need = share / (1 - r)

rejection_rate_formula: 1 - (accepted + protected) / n_candidates, where n_candidates counts only decisions carrying a non-null opus_score. Deferrals (lane_quota_full, duplicate_in_step, batch_full) are scored and therefore count as not-kept; reserve deferrals are never scored and are excluded from both terms.
